2nf.en: 2NF requires a table to be in 1NF and every non-key attribute to depend on the whole primary key, not just part of it.
2nf.hi: 2NF में टेबल पहले से 1NF में होनी चाहिए और हर non-key attribute पूरी primary key पर निर्भर होना चाहिए।
2nf.hn: 2NF ko simple language mein samjho: table pehle 1NF mein ho, aur har non-key attribute poori primary key par depend kare, sirf uske ek hisse par nahi.
2nf.q: A relation is in 2NF if it is in 1NF and no non-prime attribute is partially dependent on any candidate key.

transaction.en: A transaction is a logical unit of work that follows ACID. COMMIT makes changes permanent; ROLLBACK undoes them.
transaction.hi: Transaction काम की एक logical इकाई है जो ACID का पालन करती है।
transaction.hn: Transaction ek logical unit of work hai jo ACID follow karta hai. COMMIT changes ko permanent karta hai, ROLLBACK unhe undo karta hai.
transaction.q: COMMIT makes the changes permanent while ROLLBACK reverts the database to the last committed state.
